_comment: Recon mode targets. CertWatch passively maps a target's attack surface from Certificate Transparency — every subdomain that gets a cert shows up here, ranked by recon value (credentials > internal/admin > entry points > infra > non-prod). AUTHORIZATION: only list targets you are permitted to assess (your own assets, bug-bounty scope, or an engagement with written permission). This is passive OSINT — it reads public logs and never connects to, scans, or probes the hosts. Add registrable (eTLD+1) domains to 'targets'. The default set is used by demo mode.
